annotations.title: Welcome screen, ice breakers and menu for Messenger / Instagram DMs

description: What EVERY person sees before they write: on Messenger the Get Started button and greeting, and on Messenger and Instagram the ice breakers (up to 4 suggested questions) and the persistent menu (up to 20 items, each a link or a reply tap). action "get" reads it from Meta; "set" and "delete" change it and are confirm-gated: without confirm:true they return the before and after and change nothing. The answer is read back from Meta, and anything Meta did not keep is named. Instagram has no greeting or Get Started button. Messenger shows a menu only when a Get Started button is set. Meta allows 10 changes per 10 minutes per Page. 0 credits.

account.description: which Instagram account: an @handle or id from list_connector_accounts("instagram")

composerInputDisabled.description: Messenger only: hide the typing box so people use the menu

confirm.description: true only after the user agreed to the previewed change

getStarted.description: Messenger: true, or the payload the tap sends back

greeting.description: Messenger welcome text, up to 160 characters, or one per locale (a "default" one required)

iceBreakers.description: up to 4 questions, or per locale

pageId.description: Facebook Page id; omit when only one Page is connected

persistentMenu.description: menu items: a url opens a page, otherwise the tap sends payload

platform.description: which surface (default MESSENGER; INSTAGRAM for a direct account)
